title: Qlik Data Connection Failures
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), QRS API task/audit (`qlik:qrs`), and Qlik Cloud events.
app: Qlik Sense logs via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Repository Service (QRS) API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs; QlikView/NPrinting event logs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:scheduler ("Connection failed" OR "Cannot open connection" OR "ODBC")
| rex "connection '(?<connection>[^']+)'"
| stats count as failures by connection, task_name
| sort - failures
description: Surfaces Qlik reload failures caused by broken data connections (ODBC, REST, file shares), the most common root cause of reload breakage after credential or network changes.
value: Connection failures break reloads en masse after a password rotation; grouping by connection points straight at the shared root cause.
implementation: Ingest scheduler reload logs; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on connection failures, especially after credential changes.
visualization: Table of connection by failures, timechart.
grandmaExplanation: We catch when Qlik cannot reach a data source so a single expired login does not quietly break many apps.
